Name: Gemstone Tree
Author: Wandox99
Description:
[size=2]Hello everyone!
[/size][size=2]This mod add 7 Gemstone Tree:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Amethyst Tree; Make minerals on Summer[/size]
[*][size=2]Aquamarine Tree; Make minerals on Winter[/size]
[*][size=2]Diamond Tree; Make minerals on Winter[/size]
[*][size=2]Emerald Tree; Make minerals on Spring[/size]
[*][size=2]Jade Tree; Make minerals on Spring[/size]
[*][size=2]Ruby Tree; Make minerals on Fall[/size]
[*][size=2]Topaz Tree; Make minerals on Fall[/size]
[/list]
[size=2]You can buy the sapling from the Dwarf.[/size]

[size=4]Language avaible:
[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]English[/size]
[*][size=2]Italian[/size]
[*][size=2]German[/size]
[*][size=2]Korean[/size]
[*][size=2]Hungarian[/size]
[*][size=2]French[/size]
[*][size=2]Chinese[/size]
[*][size=2]Japanese[/size]
[*][size=2]Portuguese[/size]
[*][size=2]Turnkish[/size]
[*][size=2]Russian[/size]
[*][size=2]Spanish[/size]
[/list]
[size=3]If you liked the mod, please leave an endorsement![/size]

[size=2]I want to add a Prismatic Tree, but first I want to find a way to solve the one-season problem. Maybe in future I can add it on the Summer if isn't possible to resolve this.[/size]


[size=5]Install[/size]
[size=2]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][size=2].[/size]
[size=2]2. Install [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url][size=2].[/size]
[size=2]3. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[size=2]4. Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]

[size=2] If you have suggestion or feedback feel free to write me on the [url=http://discord.gg/stardewvalley]official Discord server[/url]﻿ with the tag @Wandox#6064 in the modmaking channels.[/size]
